title: Legal Assistant
description:
Senior Legal Assistant - Commercial Property & Agriculture
Stamford, Lincolnshire
Competitive Salary + Excellent Benefits

Are you an experienced Legal Assistant looking to take the next step in your career within a highly respected Commercial Property and Agriculture team?

The role offers exposure to a varied Commercial Property and Agriculture caseload, with the opportunity to broaden knowledge across multiple legal disciplines. Supported by a dedicated document production team, you will become an integral part of a collaborative and professional team.

Benefits
- Competitive salary
- Life assurance
- Salary exchange pension scheme
- Income protection
- Staff discounts on legal fees
- Discounted wealth management services
- Ongoing training and development opportunities
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Take the Next Step

This is an outstanding opportunity for an ambitious Legal Assistant seeking a long-term career move within a thriving Commercial Property and Agriculture team. If you are looking to join a firm that values teamwork, professional development and exceptional client service, this role offers the perfect platform to build your future.

Apply today to be considered for this exciting opportunity. Interviews are being arranged on a rolling basis, and early applications are encouraged.
